RedirectAllRequestsTo.description: Specifies the redirect behavior of all requests to a website endpoint of an Amazon S3 bucket.

IndexDocument.description: The name of the index document for the website (for example index.html).

ErrorDocument.description: The object key name of the website error document to use for 4XX class errors.

RoutingRules.description: Rules that define when a redirect is applied and the redirect behavior.
